render_used: Exports/BlackCloak/BlackCloak.fbx (LOD0, 84,612 tris, measured) imported into a copy of Assets/BlackCloak.blend (all original objects removed); cloth shader replicates the shipped UE MI_Cloak_Black (M_Cloak_Recolor): Base = CloakColor(0.013702,0.01355,0.0134) * saturate(T_BlackCloak_BaseColor.R_linear/0.013702), Roughness = T_BlackCloak_Roughness.R, Specular 0.08, Normal = T_BlackCloak_Normal_OpenGL (Blender equivalent of the DirectX file), UV0 tiling 1.0; clasp steel/leather constants from unreal_recolor_setup.py. Cycles 384 spp + OIDN, Standard view, lights calibrated so an albedo-1 card reads 0.95 linear (paper white). Camera 100 mm, yaw 0, pitch 3 deg (grid fit: best yaw -10/pitch 5 scored IoU 0.928 at full res vs 0.934 front).

clasp_centre.note: ref ring ~25 px thick flat oval band + leather strap up to shoulder; ours ~20 px thin round ring with a diagonal pin, no visible strap

upper_overlap_edge_ends.note: positions match; ref edges roll with visible thickness + undercut shadow, ours read as thin creases

hem_bottom_y.note: ours square-cut strips hang below the flared hem

centre_inner_hem.ref: continuous dark inner layer hem at y~622
centre_inner_hem.ours: see-through gaps (background visible) x~190-220 below y~607 and between strips

collar.ref_visual_wrap_folds: 5-6 diagonal wrapped folds sweeping to viewer-right, visible inner rim
collar.ours_visual: 4 horizontal soft rings on a straight cone, no wrap direction

hems.ref_form: flared, rippling godet hem with staggered frayed layers
hems.ours_form: straight-cut vertical strips with square ends, gaps between
